title: Bounded equation: where Newton's second law breaks

steps.annotation: Newton's second law — the relationship every undergraduate learns first
The unstated assumption: Newton's law works only when velocity is small relative to the speed of light
Relativistic generalization: momentum is what's conserved, with the Lorentz factor γ correcting for relative motion
At relativistic speeds, the Newtonian equation diverges from reality. Same shape; different domain.

source: Standard derivation in any introductory special-relativity text
